```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(httr2)
library(purrr)
```

```{r}
wayback_urls <- c(
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20150101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20170101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20190101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20210101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20220201012049/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/"
)
snapshot_years <- c(2015, 2017, 2019, 2021, 2022)

fetch_imdb_snapshot <- \(address, snapshot_year) {
  response <- tryCatch(
    request(address) |>
      req_timeout(seconds = 120) |>
      req_retry(max_tries = 3) |>
      req_perform(),
    error = \(e) {
      message("Could not retrieve the ", snapshot_year, " Wayback snapshot: ", conditionMessage(e))
      NULL
    }
  )

  if (is.null(response)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  page <- response |> resp_body_string() |> read_html()
  imdb_table <- page |> html_table() |> pluck(1)
  rating_tooltips <- page |>
    html_elements("td.ratingColumn strong") |>
    html_attr("title")

  rank_title <- tibble(rank_title = imdb_table$`Rank & Title`) |>
    mutate(rank_title = str_squish(rank_title)) |>
    separate_wider_regex(
      rank_title,
      patterns = c(
        rank = "\\d+",
        "\\.\\s*",
        title = ".*",
        "\\s*\\(",
        year = "\\d{4}",
        "\\)"
      )
    ) |>
    mutate(title = str_trim(title))

  tibble(
    snap_year = as.integer(snapshot_year),
    rank = as.integer(rank_title$rank),
    title = rank_title$title,
    year = as.integer(rank_title$year),
    rating = as.numeric(imdb_table$`IMDb Rating`),
    number = rating_tooltips |>
      str_extract("(?<=based on )[0-9,]+") |>
      parse_number()
  )
}

imdb_snapshot_results <- map2(wayback_urls, snapshot_years, fetch_imdb_snapshot)
imdb_snapshots <- list_rbind(imdb_snapshot_results)
print(imdb_snapshots)
print(imdb_snapshots |> count(snap_year))
```

```{r}
rank_changes <- imdb_snapshots |>
  filter(snap_year %in% c(2015, 2022)) |>
  select(title, year, snap_year, rank) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = snap_year, values_from = rank, names_prefix = "rank_") |>
  drop_na() |>
  mutate(
    release_decade = year - year %% 10,
    rank_change = rank_2022 - rank_2015
  )

rank_changes |>
  arrange(desc(abs(rank_change))) |>
  slice_head(n = 10) |>
  select(title, year, release_decade, rank_2015, rank_2022, rank_change)
```

```{r}
average_rank_change <- rank_changes |>
  group_by(release_decade) |>
  summarize(avg_rank_change = mean(rank_change), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(release_decade)
print(average_rank_change)
```

```{r}
average_rank_change |>
  mutate(
    release_decade = factor(release_decade, levels = sort(unique(release_decade))),
    rank_direction = if_else(avg_rank_change > 0, "Rose", "Fell")
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = avg_rank_change, y = release_decade, fill = rank_direction)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Rank number direction",
    values = c("Fell" = "#2C7FB8", "Rose" = "#D95F02")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Average IMDb Rank Change by Release Decade",
    subtitle = "Comparing 2015 and 2022 snapshots",
    x = "Average rank change (2022 rank - 2015 rank)",
    y = "Release decade",
    caption = "Sample: 190 films appearing in both the 2015 and 2022 snapshots."
  )
```
